update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.9 - Upstream bug fixes + support-card dating schedule
Fixed ----- - Smart Race Solver could tap the wrong same-track race sibling (e.g. Japanese Oaks vs. Tokyo Yushun, both "Tokyo Turf 2400m") in two code paths that were missing the existing fan-count disambiguation check. - Rank-optimize skill strategy could miscount purchases by including auto-obtained/unavailable base skills. - Circle/cross skill icons OCR-misread as trailing letters are now recovered. - Cached skill titles are now fuzzy-corrected so OCR misreads still resolve. - Stopped warning when a skill chain ends at an unreleased version. - Event Log Visualizer now correctly detects race and scenario details. - The app drawer getting stuck is fixed (GestureHandlerRootView was imported but never used to wrap the app). - Remote Log Viewer's race history tooltip is now clamped within the viewport.
Added ----- - Support-card recreation ("dating") schedule: pin specific career turns for recreation outings, with built-in presets (Team Sirius, Heirs to the Throne) or a hand-edited custom calendar. A pinned turn takes priority over every action except mandatory career-goal races. Optionally holds the final outing for a "Pure Passion" turn, with catch-up and abandon handling if the schedule falls behind. Off by default.
